content.text: Search index rebuilds after schema changes are triggered per project via support tools. Customers with many projects need a self-serve bulk kickoff and visibility into which projects finished.

POST /v2/admin/reindex with project_keys[] (or all=true for workspace admins) enqueues reindex jobs and returns a run_id. GET /v2/admin/reindex/{run_id} lists per-project status: queued, running, done, failed, with counts and error summaries.
Acceptance: cannot start a second overlapping all=true run; failed projects are retryable via POST .../retry; progress visible within 10s of worker updates.
